annotations.title: How hard is it to book

description: The measured booking record for one restaurant: how often a two-top and a four-top are actually open, how many dates were checked, its booking window and release hour. Use this to answer whether a restaurant is realistically gettable, or why someone keeps failing to book it. Figures are measured from SnagRes's own availability checks.
